shared_elements: more than one animal facing the same direction
animals arranged in a horizontal row
justification: Both surfaces show quadrupeds in profile aligned in a horizontal row facing the same way, which is about as generic as animal iconography gets. B additionally depicts human figures touching and leading horned rams with detailed fleece, horns and dress, an entire narrative element absent from A, whose animals are reduced to bare outline strokes with no interior detail, horns or attendant figures.
